summary: Backend regression after N+1/projection optimization sweep. Verified GET /api/customers aggregation-based orders_count is exact-match with per-customer /orders endpoint, GET /api/customers/{cid}/orders returns array (17 fields incl. items), and GET /api/dashboard/stats correctness via end-to-end scenario: placed guest order subtotal Rs.500 (Cap x1 + Cold Brew x2) -> total Rs.525; before-complete stats showed orders_today +1 with todays_sales unchanged and pending +1 (rejects non-completed from sales); after-complete stats showed todays_sales +525.00 (6247.5 -> 6772.5), orders_today +1 (14 -> 15), completed_today +1 (11 -> 12), pending back to 3. Shapes match spec: customers list has id/name/mobile_number/total_points/created_at/updated_at/orders_count and no password_hash. Dashboard returns todays_sales/orders_today/monthly_sales/pending_orders/completed_today/recent_orders.
passed: GET /api/customers -> 200, list of 6, correct fields, no password_hash
orders_count matches len(GET /api/customers/{cid}/orders) for ALL 6 customers (1,3,0,6,1,1 all OK)
GET /api/customers/{cid}/orders returns full order docs with expected 17 keys
POST /api/orders (guest, subtotal 500) -> tax 25, total 525, status order_placed
GET /api/dashboard/stats before-complete: order_placed did NOT increment todays_sales, only orders_today and pending_orders
GET /api/dashboard/stats after-complete: todays_sales exactly +525.0, orders_today +1, completed_today +1, pending_orders reverted
monthly_sales also incremented by 525.0 (only completed counted)
recent_orders array populated in dashboard response
